column1: # P0 smoke cases (design proposal §16.3). One row per case, tab-separated:
# case | level | what it checks | check | needs
# check: go-test:<package>:<test-name-regex> runs that Go test in server/;
#        manual:<reason> has no automated check and is recorded exception.
# needs: none | CH_TEST_DATABASE_URL (PostgreSQL integration test)
#        | real-pc (real PC client + real model/DSH, never available here)
# Fail-closed (P3-3): the gate exits 0 only when fail == 0. A case with no
# evidence (mapped test gone, every mapped test skipped, every subtest
# skipped) is a failure, not a pass. Exceptions are only the two
# auto-detected environment limits above (no test DB, no real PC); they are
# recorded and printed as a notice, never counted as pass.
# level is the §16.3 level (S = service, P = PC, D = real DSH); the smoke
# record also stores what the mapped check actually executed, so a pass never
# claims an unexercised layer passed.
